name: Hedron
author: E. T. Carter
description: The five Platonic solids cross-fade one into the next — tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, dodecahedron, icosahedron — a single satin-shaded form forever rebuilding itself under a soft studio key and rim light. The keystone of the Polytope set: an exact SDF for each regular solid, beveled and slowly turning.

params.label: Morph
params.effect: How fast one solid melts into the next; 0 freezes on a single polyhedron.

params.label: Bevel
params.effect: Edge rounding — low keeps razor corners, high softens the solid toward a pillow.

params.label: Light
params.effect: Strength of the studio key and specular sheen, from matte to polished satin.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Tumble speed of the solid on its diagonal axis.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera around the form; 0 ignores the mouse.
